anomaly_name: Payroll and linked GL duplicate counting

p19_remediation_mechanism: CrossSourceCashReconciliationEngine suppresses linkedCycleId duplicate; PayrollCashAdapter resolves paymentDate fallback

anomaly_name: Invoice cash omission and partial payments
original_p18_defect: AnalyticsEngine(CASH) omitted invoices (12000 vs 32000/37000) breaking Card 1 - Card 2 = Card 3; PARTIALLY_PAID invoices without payments[] ignored
p19_remediation_mechanism: AnalyticsEngine passes scopedInvoices to executeNormalizedCashPipeline; InvoiceCashAdapter parses amount_paid/amountPaid without payments[]

anomaly_name: OTHER credit account classified as revenue and expense
original_p18_defect: type OTHER with credit_account 4100_SERVICE_REV was counted as both revenue (30000) and expense (11000) yielding profit 19000 vs canonical 24000
p19_remediation_mechanism: AnalyticsEngine.computeOperationalExpenses excludes Class 4xxx/7xxx credit accounts from expenses; LedgerCashAdapter treats credit 4100 as cash INFLOW
independent_expected_output: Revenue: 30000 HTG; Non-Payroll Expenses: 8000 HTG (6000 opex + 2000 pen); Net: 22000 HTG
p19_engine_observed_output: Revenue: 30000 HTG; Expenses: 8000 HTG; Profit: 22000 HTG
